handoff_instructions: M2-T10 'Create lead tool' implemented. New: supabase/migrations/0005_lead_idempotency.sql (nullable leads.idempotency_key + partial unique index on (organization_id, idempotency_key), mirroring business_events); packages/core/src/services/leads.ts (createLead + getLead); packages/core/test/leads.test.ts. Changed: packages/domain/src/types.ts (LEAD_STATUSES/LEAD_SOURCES/Lead type), packages/domain/src/schemas.ts (createLeadInput), packages/domain/src/events.ts (EVENT_TYPES.leadCreated), packages/domain/src/permissions.ts (lead.read/lead.write permissions; lead.write added to STAFF_WRITE and AUTOMATED_PERMISSIONS so the agent actor can call it as a GREEN action), packages/core/src/rows.ts (toLead), packages/core/src/index.ts (export services/leads). createLead validates cross-org customer/employee/communication refs, is idempotent on (organization_id, idempotency_key) (on conflict do nothing + select-existing, same pattern as approvals/business_events), records a lead.created business event, and relies on the existing leads_audit DB trigger (0004_leads.sql) for the audit_log row (services do not double-write audit when a table already has an audit trigger, per the customer/employee/vendor/job/task/document convention). Tests cover: create+event+audit, duplicate-key idempotency (done_when), cross-org customer rejection, cross-org originating-communication rejection, field_employee denial, and cross-org getLead isolation. pnpm lint/typecheck/test all pass (packages/core: 145 passed, 7 skipped). Next: M2-T11 'Callback task tool'.
